title: DOM Manipulation
description: Interacting with the Document Object Model using JavaScript.

quiz.question: What does DOM stand for in JavaScript?
quiz.explanation: DOM stands for Document Object Model, which represents the structure of an HTML document.

quiz.question: Which method is used to select an element by its ID?
quiz.explanation: `getElementById()` returns the element that has the ID attribute with the specified value.

quiz.question: What does `document.querySelector('.btn')` select?
quiz.explanation: `querySelector()` returns the first matching element, in this case, one with class 'btn'.

quiz.question: Which method adds a new HTML element to the DOM?
quiz.explanation: `appendChild()` inserts a node as the last child of a parent node.

quiz.question: Which method is used to create a new DOM element?
quiz.explanation: `createElement()` creates an Element Node with the specified tag name.

quiz.question: How do you change the text inside a paragraph with JavaScript?
quiz.explanation: `innerText` sets or returns the text content of the specified node.

quiz.question: How do you remove an element from the DOM?
quiz.explanation: To remove an element, you call `removeChild()` on the parent element.

quiz.question: Which property is used to change an element's CSS style directly?
quiz.explanation: `element.style` allows you to change the inline CSS of a DOM element.

quiz.question: What does `classList.add('active')` do?
options: Adds a new element with class 'active'
Adds the class 'active' to the element
quiz.correctAnswer: Adds the class 'active' to the element
quiz.explanation: `classList.add()` is used to add one or more classes to an element.

quiz.question: Which method is used to attach a click event listener?
quiz.explanation: `addEventListener()` is used to set up a function that will be called when the specified event is delivered to the target.
